_what: The format map: every format-like name the video chain holds, sorted into what it really is, with duplicates grouped and the open calls. A PROPOSAL built from the lists as they stand on 2026-11-17 and the owner's rulings of 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-02; nothing in any bank has been changed.

parts.name: Hook
parts.what: The first seconds. One job: earn the next beat.
parts.choices: **Hook type** (what it does) × **hook format** (how it is made, when that differs from the body)

parts.name: Body
parts.choices: **Script format** (what it says) × **production format** (how it is made)

parts.name: Close
parts.choices: Offer, ask and end frame, from the offer bank

around: **Set once for the whole ad:** avatar · angle · awareness · structure · style · delivery · caption look · maker

layers.name: Angle
layers.test: One sentence she could agree or disagree with.
layers.eg: the razor was never the problem

layers.name: Awareness and framework
layers.q: How much does she already know, and in what order do we argue?
layers.test: Changes which sections the ad has and their order.
layers.eg: problem aware: problem, mechanism, proof, offer

layers.name: Script format
layers.test: Film it three different ways and it is still the same idea.
layers.today: 7 in the bank, 8 more in a second list, 14 named only inside recipes

layers.name: Production format
layers.test: It needs its own production line: different things on screen, or something else carrying the sound.
layers.eg: single presenter · song ad · text thread
layers.today: 3 in the bank, 8 recipes outside it

layers.name: Hook type
layers.q: What do the first seconds do?
layers.test: Swap it and the body does not change.
layers.today: 13 types, used only by the variations tool

layers.name: Hook format
layers.q: How is the opening made, when it is made differently from the body?
layers.test: A stunt or spectacle that ends where the pitch starts.
layers.eg: a faked impossible moment, then the pitch
layers.today: filed as full formats and recipes

layers.name: Structure
layers.q: What is the beat-by-beat build of the proven post we are borrowing?
layers.test: Same mechanic with different footage is the same structure.
layers.eg: talking head under a fixed headline
layers.today: 52 from organic posts, 50 not yet reviewed

layers.name: Style
layers.test: Change it and the script and the shots stay the same.

layers.name: Delivery
layers.test: Same words, different person saying them.

layers.name: Caption look
layers.q: How do the words sit on screen?

layers.name: Maker
layers.test: AI, a creator, or the founder.

production.name: Single presenter
production.what: One person to camera. Their voice carries it.
production.note: Also filed a second time as a variant of the multi-speaker recipe.

production.name: Multi-speaker scene
production.what: Two or more people in a room, talking to each other and to the lens.
production.folds: sports interview · talking object (the same scene, animated)
production.note: Not in the bank, so production refuses it by name today.

production.name: Narrator montage
production.what: One voice over a run of shots. Nobody talks on screen.
production.folds: voiceover explainer · voiceover montage · voiceover pitch · narrated story · animated explainer (the same thing in an animated look)
production.runs: 5 briefs, none produced on the chain
production.note: Five names for one thing today.

production.name: Song ad
production.what: A song carries it. Every sung line is a clip.
production.folds: freestyle battle · music-video narrative · character song
production.note: The only format with settings of its own in production.

production.name: Short movie
production.what: A story acted out with no words: sound effects and music only.

production.name: Text thread
production.what: Drawn in code. No people, no camera.
production.note: No teardown, writing or production path.

hook_formats.name: VFX stunt
hook_formats.what: One impossible, obviously faked moment in real handheld footage, then straight to the pitch.
hook_formats.now: filed as a full production recipe

hook_formats.name: Fake billboard stunt
hook_formats.what: A giant billboard comes alive on a real street and hands the product out.
hook_formats.now: filed as a full production recipe, with 2 variants

hook_formats.name: Dramatic continuation
hook_formats.what: Watch-bait drama that cuts to the sales pitch.
hook_formats.now: filed as a format and as a variant of the multi-speaker recipe

hook_formats.name: Weird stunt, then the pitch
hook_formats.what: An attention toll that has nothing to do with the offer, then the reveal.

script_groups.name: In the bank (7)
script_groups.names: remedy · demonstration · expert consultation · testimonial montage · meme · micro-drama · comedy skit
script_groups.note: Each is also filed as a variant under a production recipe, which mixes the two kinds. Remedy sits in four places and its caption look is under a fifth name.

script_groups.name: In a second list only (7)
script_groups.names: letter to my younger self · then and now photo · home video flashback · classic commercial remake · infomercial throwback · era roll call · continue screen
script_groups.note: The teardown and writing accept these. Production refuses them: they are not in the bank. 17 idea-only runs used era roll call and none reached a brief.

script_groups.name: Named only inside recipes (14)
script_groups.names: TV shopping · grandma explainer · body-scan recipe · public reaction · expert stitch · expert reaction · split-screen comparison · makeover reveal · founder story · VSL · expert VSL · founder VSL · symptom checker · problem-solution dance
script_groups.note: Never defined anywhere. Most arrived when a recipe was built from one swipe.

script_groups.name: Filed as structures (2)
script_groups.names: before, turn, after story · timeline turn
script_groups.note: These are argument shapes, not beat-by-beat builds.

script_groups.name: Borrowed shows (11)
script_groups.names: fight night · cooking show · soap opera · home shopping · courtroom · true crime · game show · home makeover · nature documentary · analyst desk · boss fight
script_groups.note: A show is a script format with six roles to cast. Nothing in the chain reads this list as a format.

same_thing: **An expert carries it:** expert consultation · expert stitch · expert reaction · expert VSL
**Real people vouch for it:** testimonial montage · public reaction · stranger answer montage
**The product does the work:** demonstration · TV shopping · body-scan recipe · makeover reveal
**A long straight pitch:** VSL · expert VSL · founder VSL (who tells it is the maker, not the format)
**A played character:** comedy skit · character sketch · micro-drama

not_formats.name: Ad series
not_formats.is: a run of ads, each with its own format

not_formats.name: Founder story, founder VSL
not_formats.is: the maker (founder) plus a script format

not_formats.name: Animated explainer
not_formats.is: narrator montage in an animated style

not_formats.name: The 3D world skit tool
not_formats.is: a way to make scenes, not a format

not_formats.name: Copy formats (16) and email formats
not_formats.is: other outputs that share the word

calls.q: An ad is hook, body and close, and the hook gets its own two choices.
calls.yes: The 4 stunt-type names move out of formats into hook formats.
Five voiceover names become narrator montage; three song names become song ad.

calls.q: Script formats stop being filed under production recipes.
calls.yes: Remedy, demonstration and the rest are named once, beside the production format, on every run.

calls.q: The 7 nostalgia formats join the bank as script formats.
The same-thing groups each become one script format with variants.
Ad series is a container, not a format.
